name: expanded-chat
js: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#root > div'); f.style.outline = 'none'; f.style.right = '24px'; f.style.bottom = '24px'; const box = document.querySelector('.chat-input textarea'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(box, 'Any wisdom for me today?'); box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); document.querySelector('.chat-input button[type=submit]').click(); })()
